title: Mosaico
style: Soviet mosaic panel, tesserae and cement joints
idiom: Soviet mosaic panel (bus stop / palace of culture), heroic workers and agriculture
rule: A 34x24 tessera grid with per-cell colour jitter; every 97th tessera is displaced and darkened, and the background jitter is biased toward warm red inside a five-point star, so a second image exists only at a distance.

readings.far: At 400 px: a bordered mosaic panel with a red star burned into the field behind a worker and a peasant woman.
readings.middle: At 1600 px: the heroic figure group (cream shirt, blue overalls, hammer; red dress, cream apron, gold sheaf), the sun, the border course, the tesserae.
readings.near: At 100%: grout joints, per-tile rotation and colour jitter, missing tiles, patina, and a diagonal thread of tesserae that are out of place every 97 tiles; the star dissolves into tile noise.

techniques: 34x24 tessera grid, per-tile rotation and colour jitter
point-in-polygon figure composition rasterised to tesserae
hidden second image as a colour bias inside a five-point star
every 97th tessera displaced, rotated and darkened (diagonal thread)
border course, cement joints, missing tiles and patina
statement: A public wall carries two images: the commission (worker, woman, sun, harvest) and the one the field makes when you step back — a red star hidden in the tiles. Up close it is material, grout, repair and one tile in ninety-seven out of place.
